content: Internal Revenue Service Compliance Division, this is Agent Miller. Am I speaking with Mr. Patel, owner of Synerbyte Solutions?
Yes, this is Ravi Patel. I got a message about urgent IRS business, is something wrong?
Mr. Patel, I'm calling regarding severe discrepancies in your federal tax compliance for 2023, specifically with late or missing 1099 filings and payroll tax deposits. Are you aware of these issues?
No, I thought I submitted everything. I just work as a contractor, I don't even have employees.

Unfortunately, our records indicate otherwise. The IRS has flagged your account for non-compliance regarding both 1099 submissions and quarterly payroll tax returns. This can lead to an immediate audit and heavy penalties unless addressed now.
Oh no, I really didn't know. I'm on a visa, I can't have any legal problems. What should I do?

I understand the seriousness, Mr. Patel. However, because of these violations, your business license and visa sponsorship are at risk. If you fail to resolve this today, the IRS can initiate an asset freeze and notify immigration authorities.
Please, I don't want to have problems with immigration. Is there any way to fix this? I can cooperate.
There are steep fines associated with these violations, but you may still qualify for a pre-audit resolution. This requires immediate payment of the outstanding penalties to halt escalation.
Okay, can I pay with my bank account? How much is it?

The total penalty for late filings and non-compliance is $3,200. Due to the urgency, the only accepted payment methods today are through direct wire transfer or instant cryptocurrency deposit. Do you have access to either?
I've never used crypto before. I do have a bank account, but I need to know this is not a mistake. Is there paperwork I can get?
If you hesitate, the case will automatically escalate. Right now, you're being offered a one-time settlement. If you speak to anyone or hang up, this window closes and formal legal action begins.
No, no, I want to fix it. Please don't call anyone else. What do I do?

To process the payment, I need you to remain on this call. Do not discuss this with anyone, as it's an active compliance investigation. Are you able to access your online banking or a Bitcoin wallet right now?
I can use online banking, but I'm not sure how this works for the IRS. Can you send me instructions?

For security, we will provide the official wire transfer details over the phone. Alternatively, you can purchase $3,200 in certified government gift cards from an authorized retailer. I will stay on the line to guide you.
Gift cards? That sounds strange. Are you sure this is normal IRS process?
This is a secure compliance protocol for urgent cases. If you delay, a federal agent will be assigned to your address for a business audit and possible asset seizure.
I'm really scared. I can try to get the cards now. Should I go to the store?
Yes. Go to a Walgreens or CVS and buy $3,200 worth of Apple or Visa gift cards. Stay on this call while you make the purchase. Do not hang up or speak to store staff about your situation.
Okay, I'm leaving now. Please don't call immigration. I'm on my way.
Good. Once you have the cards, read the numbers and codes on the back to me for immediate compliance confirmation. If you fail to do so, enforcement action will proceed without further warning.
I understand. I just want this to be over.
